description.name: Entry
description.text:
15 single-target Fire/Earth/NE physical attacks, Fire/Earth Ability Damage +30% for 1 turn to party, Awoken Knight of Grandshelt Mode, Cap Break Level 1, Twin Element Mode II & Blood Linkage to user
Awoken Knight of Grandshelt Mode: Unlimited Fire/Earth Hones, Fire/Earth Rank Quick Cast & chases Fire/Earth abilities with 6 single-target Fire/Earth/NE physical attacks
Twin Element Mode II: En-Fire Stack or En-Earth Stack
Blood Linkage: After using 2 Fire/Earth abilities, grants Fire/Earth Ability Damage +30% for 1 turn to party
